Q6-wsV5B81ttJLFVLIBSfw.zh: 香港於6/12通報之2歲男童新型A型流感(H9)感染病例(前已掌握),經基因定序和分析,確認為低致病性A(H9N2)病毒株 ,且未檢測到明顯基因變異。患者目前病情穩定,與其同住6人均無症狀,評估當地流行風險低。自1999年以來,香港累計11例H9N2病例,其中5例為本地病例,6例為輸入性病例。
Q6-wsV5B81ttJLFVLIBSfw.en: A 2-year-old boy in Hong Kong, reported on 12 June, was infected with novel influenza A (H9), previously identified. Genetic sequencing and analysis confirmed a low-pathogenicity A(H9N2) virus, with no significant genetic mutations detected. The patient is currently stable, and all 6 people living with him are asymptomatic. The local transmission risk is assessed as low. Since 1999, Hong Kong has cumulatively reported 11 H9N2 cases, of which 5 were local cases and 6 were imported.

4wv3TXDcjBddmgSAl0saZQ.zh: 人類疫情:香港新增1例H9人類感染病例。全球今年累計報告27例,分別為16例H9N2、1例H9、7例H5N1、1例H5N6、1例H10N3及1例H1N2v,個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 香港於6/12通報沙田區新增1例H9人類感染病例,為2歲男童,6/9出現發燒及輕微腹瀉症狀,6/10就醫,目前情況穩定,經檢驗證實對A(H9)流感病毒呈陽性,分型結果待定。調查顯示,個案於潛伏期內無外遊,屬本地感染,家中無飼養禽鳥,亦無食用未經煮熟家禽或接觸病人,惟6月初曾與家人於販售活雞店家逗留觀看家禽,並觸摸該店周遭環境,當局已對感染源及接觸者進行調查,接觸者迄未出現症狀。香港自1999年起累計報告10例A(H9N2)病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):今年累計59國家/地區報告3,635起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。 共6國於2026/6/9-12期間報告58起H5N1疫情,德國40起、美國7起、法國5起、塞爾維亞4起、挪威/立陶宛各1起。
4wv3TXDcjBddmgSAl0saZQ.en: Human cases: Hong Kong reported 1 new H9 human infection this week. Globally, 27 cases have been reported this year: 16 H9N2, 1 H9, 7 H5N1, 1 H5N6, 1 H10N3 and 1 H1N2v. Hong Kong reported on 12 June a new H9 human infection in a 2-year-old boy in Sha Tin District, who developed fever and mild diarrhoea on 9 June and sought care on 10 June. His condition is currently stable, and testing confirmed positivity for influenza A(H9) virus, with subtyping pending. Investigation showed the case was locally acquired, with no travel during the incubation period. There were no poultry or birds at home, and he had not eaten undercooked poultry or been in contact with patients. However, in early June he and his family had visited a shop selling live chickens to watch the poultry and had touched the surroundings of the shop. Authorities are investigating the source of infection and contacts, and no contacts have shown symptoms so far. Since 1999, Hong Kong has reported 10 A(H9N2) cases cumulatively. Avian/animal outbreaks (WAHIS): 59 countries and territories have reported 3,635 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks this year. Authorities urge people who visited the venue after 1 May to strengthen health monitoring and get vaccinated. Hong Kong has reported 90 cumulative cases since 2022, of which 17 were imported.

h-JbxK-Y_i4wrt7YbHw-0Q.zh: 蘇丹南達爾富爾州(South Darfur)傑貝勒馬拉(Jebel Marra)地區爆發疑疫情。截至5/21當地通報347例病例,疫情於一週內急速攀升,目前尚未有死亡病例報告,且病毒分支(clade)與實驗室檢驗結果仍待確認。該區收容約70萬名流離失所者,極度擁擠的難民營、缺乏衛生設施與疫苗,加上醫療監測系統崩潰,致傳播風險極高。 中國近期通報2例具香港旅遊史的確診病例。2名男性(28及30歲)潛伏期內均曾造訪香港旺角同一場所,並有高風險行為,其後陸續出現發燒、腹股溝腫痛及下肢紅疹等症狀後確診。2022年迄今,香港累計86例確診病例(含69例本土與17例境外移入個案),且個案皆為男性。
h-JbxK-Y_i4wrt7YbHw-0Q.en: A suspected outbreak has occurred in the Jebel Marra area of South Darfur State, Sudan. As of 21 May, 347 cases had been reported locally. Cases rose sharply within one week. No deaths have been reported so far, and the clade and laboratory results remain pending. The area hosts about 700,000 displaced people; extremely crowded refugee camps, lack of sanitation and vaccines, and the collapse of the health monitoring system make the transmission risk extremely high. China recently reported two confirmed cases with a history of travel to Hong Kong. The two men, aged 28 and 30, both visited the same venue in Mong Kok, Hong Kong, during their incubation period and engaged in high-risk behaviour. They subsequently developed fever, groin swelling and pain, and lower-limb rashes, and were then confirmed. Since 2022, Hong Kong has reported 86 cumulative confirmed cases (69 local and 17 imported), all in men.

tIHD6xlHI7xv16Mb81YcoA.zh: 香港於今年 4/19-4/25 期間新增 5 例確定病例,其中 4 例為本土病例,病患皆為 50 歲以上,其中 3 例具慢性病史。當局已啟動疫情調查,並提醒民眾應定期保養供水系統,另高風險族群應採取相關預防措施。香港今年截至 4/25 累計報告 36 例確定病例,另於 2024-25 年分別報告 135 及 167 例確定病例。
tIHD6xlHI7xv16Mb81YcoA.en: Hong Kong reported five new confirmed cases between 19 and 25 April this year, of which four were local. All patients were aged over 50, and three had chronic illnesses. Authorities have launched an outbreak investigation and reminded the public to maintain water supply systems regularly; high-risk groups should take relevant precautions. Hong Kong has reported 36 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 25 April, and reported 135 and 167 confirmed cases in 2024–25 respectively.

gQ6OD-8iaEOn7iro8_ANoQ.zh: 香港報告今年首例本土病例,個案為 21 歲男性,於 4/12 出現發燒、頭痛、肌肉痛及出疹等症狀,4/16 就醫,目前病況穩定,於潛伏期間無旅遊史,個案表示其近期曾於工作地點附近遭蚊子叮咬,家庭接觸者及同一地點工作人員目前均無症狀,尚未發現個案與先前報告的輸入個案間有流行病學關連,當局仍持續進行調查。香港今年累計 16 例病例(其中 1 例本土病例),2025 年累計 59 例病例(均為輸入病例);2024 年累計 161 例病例(其中 5 例本土病例)。 法屬瓦利斯和富圖那之富圖納島 4/22 確診 1 例本土病例,個案近期無高風險地區旅遊史,由於鄰近之法屬新喀里多亞於今年 3 月下旬宣布爆發疫情,增加疾病傳播風險。
gQ6OD-8iaEOn7iro8_ANoQ.en: Hong Kong reported its first local case this year: a 21-year-old man who developed fever, headache, muscle pain and rash on 12 April and sought care on 16 April. His condition is stable. He had no travel history during the incubation period, but reported recent mosquito bites near his workplace. Family contacts and staff at the same workplace are currently asymptomatic. No epidemiological link has been found between this case and previously reported imported cases, and authorities continue to investigate. Hong Kong has reported 16 cases cumulatively this year (one local), 59 cases in 2025 (all imported), and 161 cases in 2024 (five local). On Futuna Island in French Wallis and Futuna, one local case was confirmed on 22 April; the case had no recent travel to high-risk areas. The neighbouring French territory of New Caledonia announced an outbreak in late March this year, which increases the risk of transmission.

gXSWLNPoN1kIDU06HiePqA.en: Hong Kong reported one local case: a 30-year-old man who developed muscle pain and fever from 14 April, presented with a rash on 17 April, and was laboratory-confirmed on 18 April. He is a close contact of the confirmed cases announced by Hong Kong on 3 and 6 April; all of them worked at the airport, and none had a history of travel abroad. Authorities have activated contact tracing for close contacts in clinics and at the airport, and urge the public to get measles vaccination. Quezon City in the National Capital Region of the Philippines reported 143 confirmed cases this year as of 16 April, including one death. 76% of patients are children under 10 (109 cases), and 23 of them were infants too young to be vaccinated. Authorities have launched related prevention and vaccination measures. In the first quarter of this year, the Philippines reported 1,627 confirmed measles and rubella cases cumulatively, 45% more than in the same period last year.

5wQBnWXRYbit6XZyVEl5jw.zh: 香港疫情更新,今年截至3月累計報告27例病例,2-3月疫情已下降(7、8例),其中3月病例均為年齡介於28-61歲男性。當局已推出免費疫苗接種措施,迄今已逾60人接種,惟近期仍持續報告有MSM經驗之病例。另香港於2015-2017年亦曾爆發MSM相關疫情,已透過高風險族群的疫苗接種措施成功控制。
5wQBnWXRYbit6XZyVEl5jw.en: Hong Kong epidemic update: as of March this year, 27 cases have been reported cumulatively. Case numbers declined in February and March (7 and 8 cases, respectively). All cases reported in March were men aged 28–61 years. Authorities have launched a free vaccination programme, and more than 60 people have been vaccinated to date; however, cases with a history of sex with men (MSM) continue to be reported. Hong Kong also experienced MSM-related outbreaks in 2015–2017, which were brought under control through vaccination of high-risk groups.

XnRYh_cgINzc277jW0TStQ.en: Hong Kong has newly reported 1 confirmed case, a 3-year-old boy who developed fever, vomiting and other symptoms on 17 March, sought medical care the next day and was hospitalized. His condition is currently serious, and testing confirmed Neisseria meningitidis. The patient had no overseas travel history during the incubation period. None of the close contacts had developed illness as of 20 March; authorities have provided preventive medication to contacts and continue the outbreak investigation. Hong Kong has reported 4 confirmed cases so far this year. Authorities said the patients are not linked to recent cluster cases in the United Kingdom, and reminded the public that overseas students are expected to return to Hong Kong during the Easter holiday; anyone with related meningitis symptoms should seek medical care as soon as possible. Hong Kong reported 11 confirmed cases last year.

Investigation found no overlap between patients' homes and the restaurants they had visited, and 14 patients reported MSM experience. Authorities' investigation does not rule out a sexual-contact-related cluster, and people who need vaccination or counselling are advised to call the hotline for advice.

4fa2D11tkxD3ZqVpyXgUpw.en: Epidemic update: In week 8 of this year (16–22 February), the global positivity rate fell to 2.75%, with a notable increase only in the WHO Eastern Mediterranean Region. Hong Kong's epidemic has risen slightly from its low point; the positivity rate increased to 0.17% in week 10, and NB.1.8.1 accounted for the largest share of variants in wastewater surveillance (62.8%). Canada's epidemic has declined slightly; the positivity rate fell to 4.7% in week 8 (22–28 February), though it remains higher than the same period last year. Patients aged over 65 account for the majority (55.9%), and NB.1.8.1 is the predominant variant. Europe's epidemic has reached a low point; the overall hospital positivity rate fell to 1.1% in week 9, and NB.1.8.1 (62%) and XFG (38%) became the main variants. Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently has the highest share of circulating variants globally (44.5%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (23.39%). WHO notes that current COVID-19 vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

She walked along the Tsing Yi trail on 29 November, developed joint pain and fever on 2 December, and was diagnosed on 5 December. Her condition is stable, and family members living with her (including companions) currently show no symptoms. So far this year, Hong Kong has confirmed 78 cases, 10 of which are locally acquired.

eJ0-p25kVJpj7IAlNlQrCg.zh: 亞洲多國疫情持續,  日本東京都第46週(11/10-16)定點門診平均病例數為44.75人,共計有1,696所學校/機構採取停課等措施,為去年同期14倍,當局表示國際流行之「H3」型K次演化群已於日本檢出,自今年9月迄今,H3檢體之K次演化群檢出率為92.3%(12/13); 韓國第43-46週病例數呈指數型上升,住院人數顯著上升,病患主要為學齡兒童及青少年,本季高峰期較去年提早2個月,以H3N2為主要流行株,另已檢出變異株,惟當局確認現有疫苗仍對該病毒株有效; 香港今年流感季累計報告21例兒童重症病例,其中2例死亡,第47週單週報告3例兒童重症病例,當局表示本流感季兒童感染嚴重個案較多,6個月至2歲以下兒童疫苗覆蓋率僅近16%,呼籲家長儘速安排兒童疫苗接種作業; 泰國今年截至11/8累計報告逾94萬例病例,其中100例死亡,病患主要為14歲以下年齡層,當局建議高風險族群應每年接種疫苗。
eJ0-p25kVJpj7IAlNlQrCg.en: Outbreaks continue in several Asian countries. Tokyo Metropolitan Government: In week 46 (10–16 November), the average number of cases per sentinel outpatient clinic was 44.75, and a total of 1,696 schools and facilities took measures such as class suspensions, 14 times the same period last year. Authorities said the internationally circulating H3 subclade K has been detected in Japan; since September this year, the detection rate of H3 subclade K among specimens has been 92.3% (12/13). South Korea: Cases rose exponentially in weeks 43–46, with hospitalizations rising significantly, mainly among school-age children and adolescents. The peak this season came two months earlier than last year, with H3N2 as the predominant strain. Variant strains have also been detected, but authorities have confirmed that existing vaccines remain effective against this strain. Hong Kong: A cumulative 21 severe pediatric cases have been reported this flu season, including 2 deaths; 3 severe pediatric cases were reported in week 47 alone. Authorities said severe infections in children have been more frequent this season, and vaccine coverage among children aged 6 months to under 2 years is only about 16%; parents are urged to arrange vaccination promptly. Thailand: A cumulative total of more than 940,000 cases and 100 deaths had been reported as of 8 November this year. Most patients are under 14 years old, and authorities recommend annual vaccination for high-risk groups.

ppgoqg59lqkzx3GOfvUvmw.zh: 香港疫情持續上升,10/26-11/20累計報告78例病例,其中有64例(占8成)發生於小學及幼兒園;當局表示每年5-7月及10-12月為疫情高峰,預期本次疫情於12月中旬達到高峰,不排除至聖誕假期才會逐漸趨緩。
ppgoqg59lqkzx3GOfvUvmw.en: Hong Kong's outbreak continues to rise. From 26 October to 20 November, 78 cases were reported cumulatively, of which 64 (80%) occurred in primary schools and kindergartens. Authorities said the outbreak peaks each year in May–July and October–December, and expect this outbreak to peak in mid-December. It may not slow gradually until the Christmas holidays.

ZFOaPM1fli1E6evTB72w3A.zh: 全球疫情更新,今年累計報告458,840例病例及146例死亡,病例數較去年同期增加,10月報告病例數較9月增加108%,近2個月病例主要分布於美洲及亞洲。  今年美洲累計266,165例病例及118例死亡,較去年同期為低,以南美洲巴西病例數最多,其中,該國中西部和東南部地區在過去3週疫情最為嚴峻,並預期11月病例數將再度上升。 今年亞洲累計136,233例病例,較去年同期為低,以東南亞印度病例數最多;中國廣東省自7月疫情爆發以來,近期每週病例數呈下降趨勢,惟10月病例數較9月增加,香港及廣西壯族自治區亦有報告病例。 今年歐洲共2國報告病例,法國累計804例本土病例;義大利累計385例本土病例。
ZFOaPM1fli1E6evTB72w3A.en: Global update: This year, 458,840 cases and 146 deaths have been reported cumulatively, with case numbers higher than the same period last year. Reported cases in October rose 108% from September, and in the past two months cases have been mainly distributed in the Americas and Asia. The Americas have reported 266,165 cumulative cases and 118 deaths this year, lower than the same period last year. Brazil has the most cases; its central-western and south-eastern regions have been the most severely affected in the past three weeks, and case numbers are expected to rise again in November. Asia has reported 136,233 cumulative cases this year, lower than the same period last year. India has the most cases in South-East Asia. In Guangdong Province, China, weekly cases have shown a declining trend since the outbreak began in July, but October cases were higher than September. Cases have also been reported in Hong Kong and the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region. Two European countries have reported cases this year: France has 804 cumulative locally acquired cases and Italy has 385.

rG9DDAeXI8qsn7Mm_kzNPA.zh: 中國廣東省近期疫情持續下降,近1週(11/9-15)新增48例病例,主要分布於江門市14例及深圳市12例,皆為輕症,無報告重症及死亡病例,近1週新增病例數較前1週107例下降;香港今年截至11/16累計62例病例,其中4例為本土病例。
rG9DDAeXI8qsn7Mm_kzNPA.en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak has continued to decline recently. In the past week (9–15 November), 48 new cases were reported, mainly in Jiangmen (14 cases) and Shenzhen (12 cases). All were mild, with no severe or fatal cases reported. New cases in the past week fell from 107 the previous week. Hong Kong: 62 cases had been reported cumulatively as of 16 November this year, of which 4 were locally acquired.

mQW9PsXlG_Kr1YUd7FcQEw.zh: 澳洲疫情嚴峻,今年累計報告逾42萬例,截至今年8月死亡265例,為2020年2月以來首次流感死亡數高於新冠死亡數。自6月下旬到8月中旬經歷長期高峰期,疫情下降速度較前幾季慢。病例超過10%為5歲以下兒童,該國今年疫苗接種率低,約為30.6%,僅約25%之5歲以下兒童接種疫苗,老年族群接種率亦下降。 日本疫情持續上升,第43週定點門診平均病例數例為6.29例,較前1週增加1.9倍,以沖繩縣19.4例為多,另東京/千葉/埼玉/神奈川等4個都縣平均病例數超過10例,全國共44個都道府縣病例數皆較前1週增加,當局表示將持續監測疫情,以應對疫情蔓延,並呼籲民眾採取個人防護並接種疫苗。 香港持續處高點,近1週(10/19-25)陽性率為12.01%,近期檢出以A(H3)為主,佔病毒檢出率近90%,另校園群聚事件通報仍處高點,自9月開學迄10/29,報告693件校園群聚,並報告16起兒童重症個案,其中1例死亡。另近期汙水病毒監測將涵蓋季節性流感病毒,以作為傳統監測系統之補充指標。
mQW9PsXlG_Kr1YUd7FcQEw.en: Australia's outbreak is severe: more than 420,000 cases have been reported this year, and 265 deaths as of August this year. This is the first time since February 2020 that influenza deaths have exceeded COVID-19 deaths. A prolonged peak lasted from late June to mid-August, and the rate of decline is slower than in previous seasons. Over 10% of cases are children under 5 years old. Vaccination coverage in the country this year is low, at about 30.6%; only about 25% of children under 5 have been vaccinated, and vaccination rates among the elderly have also declined. Japan: The outbreak continues to rise. In week 43, the average number of cases per sentinel outpatient clinic was 6.29, an increase of 1.9-fold from the previous week, with the highest figure, 19.4, in Okinawa Prefecture. Tokyo, Chiba, Saitama and Kanagawa had averages above 10 cases, and case numbers rose from the previous week in all 44 prefectures. Authorities say they will continue monitoring the outbreak to respond to its spread and urge people to take personal protective measures and get vaccinated. Hong Kong remains at a high level: positivity in the past week (19–25 October) was 12.01%. The recently detected strain is mainly A(H3), accounting for nearly 90% of virus detections. School cluster reports also remain at a high level: from the start of the school term in September to 29 October, 693 school clusters were reported, along with 16 severe paediatric cases, including one death. Wastewater virus surveillance will also now cover seasonal influenza viruses as a supplementary indicator to the traditional surveillance system.

A47rprY6eBApzoXgrrDOWQ.zh: 中國廣東省近期疫情持續下降,近1週(10/26-11/1)新增259例病例,主要分布於佛山市51例、深圳市48例、江門市44例及廣州市37例,皆為輕症,無報告重症及死亡病例,近1週新增病例數較前1週868例明顯下降;香港今年迄今累計54例病例,其中2例本土及52例移入病例。
A47rprY6eBApzoXgrrDOWQ.en: Guangdong Province, China: The outbreak continues to decline. In the past week (26 October–1 November), 259 new cases were reported, mainly in Foshan (51), Shenzhen (48), Jiangmen (44) and Guangzhou (37). All were mild, and no severe or fatal cases have been reported. New cases in the past week fell markedly from 868 the previous week. Hong Kong has reported 54 cases cumulatively this year, including 2 locally acquired cases and 52 imported cases.

YVJD3VFU4oPz_2s9FK1Mew.zh: 中國第43週(10/20-26)監測顯示,南/北方活動度及陽性率皆呈上升趨勢,主要流行型別為A(H3N2),專家表示近期氣溫驟降,進入呼吸道疾病流行季節,鄰近國家近期已提前進入流感季,評估11月下旬至12月中旬為流感高峰期。 香港處夏季流感季高峰,第42週(10/12-18)流感陽性率為11.84%,主要流行型別為A(H3N2),佔整體病毒檢出率近90%,另校園群聚事件持續上升,截至10/22累計報告608件,另今年9月開學迄今累計14例兒童流感重症個案,其中1例死亡,年齡介於2-17歲間。 日本第42週定點門診平均病例數例為3.26例,較前1週增加1.4倍,病例以沖繩縣15.04例為多,全國37個都道府縣病例數增加,另東京都截至10/19共71所學校停課,為去年同期之6倍以上。
YVJD3VFU4oPz_2s9FK1Mew.en: China: Week 43 (20–26 October) surveillance shows activity and positivity rates rising in both the south and the north, with A(H3N2) as the main circulating type. Experts say temperatures have dropped sharply recently, marking the start of the respiratory disease season. Neighbouring countries have recently entered their flu seasons early, and the influenza peak is expected between late November and mid-December. Hong Kong is at its summer flu-season peak: the positivity rate in week 42 (12–18 October) was 11.84%, with A(H3N2) as the main type, accounting for nearly 90% of total virus detections. School cluster reports continue to rise, with 608 reported cumulatively as of 22 October. Since school started in September, 14 severe paediatric influenza cases have been reported cumulatively, including one death, with patients aged between 2 and 17. Japan: The average number of cases per sentinel outpatient clinic in week 42 was 3.26, an increase of 1.4-fold from the previous week. The highest figure was 15.04 in Okinawa Prefecture. Case numbers increased in 37 prefectures nationwide. In Tokyo, 71 schools had suspended classes as of 19 October, more than six times the same period last year.

98unMX_qQgs3fV0LMLmf1g.zh: 香港疫情更新,今年截至10/22累計42例確診病例,均為移入病例,其中1名77歲有慢性病史男性個案,9/30-10/13有廣東省廣州市旅遊史,10/13出現發燒及關節痛,14日出現皮疹,入院治療後病情惡化,於22日死亡。
98unMX_qQgs3fV0LMLmf1g.en: Hong Kong update: As of 22 October this year, 42 confirmed cases had been reported cumulatively, all imported. One case was a 77-year-old man with a chronic illness who had travelled to Guangzhou, Guangdong, from 30 September to 13 October. He developed fever and joint pain on 13 October and a rash on 14 October. His condition deteriorated after admission for treatment, and he died on 22 October.

vDk0C0JCtydO9nLmm-iMnA.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第36週(9/1-7)全球陽性率18.98%,除非洲及東地中海以外,各區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點,第38週(9/15-21)門急診陽性率5.3%,較前一週下降,住院陽性率呈下降趨勢,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 香港疫情於低點,第38週陽性率下降至0.65%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 東南亞疫情處低點,第38週報告病例數及死亡數均低,其中,印度及泊爾變異株以XFG占比最高,泰國以NB.1.8.1為主。 美國疫情呈下降趨勢,第37週陽性率9.5%,已連續3週下降,住院率亦呈下降趨勢,惟死亡率仍處高點。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,除非洲及東地中海以外,各區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(72%),其次為NB.1.8.1(19%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
vDk0C0JCtydO9nLmm-iMnA.en: Update: The global positivity rate in week 36 of 2025 (1–7 September) was 18.98%, with positivity increasing in all regional offices except Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean. China: The outbreak is at a low point. The outpatient and emergency positivity rate in week 38 (15–21 September) was 5.3%, lower than the previous week, and the hospital positivity rate is also declining. The variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Hong Kong: The outbreak is at a low point. The positivity rate fell to 0.65% in week 38, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Southeast Asia: The outbreak is at a low point. In week 38, reported cases and deaths were low; the variant XFG has the highest share in India and Nepal, and NB.1.8.1 predominates in Thailand. United States: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 37 was 9.5%, having declined for three consecutive weeks; hospitalization rates are also declining, but the mortality rate remains high. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently shown an upward trend, with increases in all regional offices except Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG (72%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (19%). WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

f-_BsAkn4578CQRFUC0UBQ.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第35週(8/25-31)全球陽性率13.76%,除東南亞及非洲區署以外,各區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點波動,第37週(9/8-14)門急診陽性率6.8%,與前一週相當,住院陽性率呈下降趨勢,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 香港疫情處低點,第37週陽性率下降至0.78%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 日本疫情於高點稍降,第36週定醫平均報告數7.46,較近2週下降,病患以10歲以下為多,地理分布以東京都、大阪為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 加拿大疫情持續上升,第36週陽性率上升至8.5%,惟較近兩年同期低,住院新增283例,病患以65歲以上為多(占55%),以變異株XFG占比最高(49%)。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲、歐洲、非洲區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(62%),其次為NB.1.8.1(24%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
f-_BsAkn4578CQRFUC0UBQ.en: Epidemiological update: in week 35 of 2025 (25–31 August), global test positivity was 13.76%; positivity increased in all WHO regions except South-East Asia and Africa. China's outbreak is fluctuating at a low level; in week 37 (8–14 September), outpatient and emergency positivity was 6.8%, similar to the previous week, while inpatient positivity is declining; variant NB.1.8.1 accounts for the largest share. Hong Kong's outbreak is at a low level; positivity fell to 0.78% in week 37, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Japan's outbreak has declined slightly from its peak; the average number of sentinel reports in week 36 was 7.46, lower than in the previous two weeks. Patients are mostly under 10 years old, geographically concentrated in Tokyo and Osaka, and NB.1.8.1 accounts for the largest share. Canada's outbreak continues to rise; positivity rose to 8.5% in week 36, though still lower than the same period in the past two years. There were 283 new hospitalizations, mostly among patients aged 65 and over (55%); variant XFG accounts for the largest share (49%). Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, with rising trends in the Americas, Europe and Africa regions. The predominant global variant is XFG (62%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (24%). WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

Qy4fJyUrq-lvedilIMsy7w.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第34週(8/18-24)全球陽性率10.85%,美洲、歐洲及非洲區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點波動,8月新增約16萬例病例,其中重症187例、死亡7例,陽性率下降8%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(95.2%)。 香港疫情下降,第36週陽性率下降至1.1%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 日本疫情略降,第35週定醫平均報告數7.46,較前一週(8.8)下降,病患以10歲以下為多,地理分布以大阪、埼玉縣為多。 美國疫情經高點後稍降,第35週陽性率降為10.8%,惟已超過今年年初高峰(6.7%),死亡率呈上升,住院率呈下降趨勢,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(64%),其次為NB.1.8.1(27%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
Qy4fJyUrq-lvedilIMsy7w.en: Epidemiological update: in week 34 of 2025 (18–24 August), global test positivity was 10.85%, with increases in the Americas, Europe and Africa regions. China's outbreak is fluctuating at a low level; about 160,000 cases were reported in August, including 187 severe cases and 7 deaths; positivity declined by 8%, and variant NB.1.8.1 accounts for the largest share (95.2%). Hong Kong's outbreak is declining; positivity fell to 1.1% in week 36, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Japan's outbreak has declined slightly: the sentinel average in week 35 was 7.46, down from 8.8 the previous week. Patients are mostly under 10 years old, and cases are geographically concentrated in Osaka and Saitama Prefecture. The US outbreak has declined slightly from its peak: positivity fell to 10.8% in week 35, but remains above this year's early-year peak (6.7%); mortality is rising and hospitalization rates are declining, with XFG the variant with the largest share. SUbzF8aWQXSkpTUfB8dfFg.en: The US reported its second and third clade I cases in January and February respectively. Case 2 was in Georgia and case 3 in New Hampshire, and both were confirmed after returning from affected areas; the two cases are not linked. Authorities have launched an epidemiological investigation and recommend vaccination for high-risk people. The risk to the general public is assessed as low, and low to moderate for people with high-risk sexual behaviour. Hong Kong reported one new case, a 37-year-old man with a chronic illness and high-risk exposure. He developed symptoms on 28 January, sought care on 4 February, and is in isolation; the source of infection is still under investigation. UNICEF reported that the Democratic Republic of the Congo recorded 64,173 suspected cases, 14,053 confirmed cases and 1,341 deaths in 2024 (CFR: 2.08%). Reported cases have trended downward since mid-October 2024, although confirmed numbers are still fluctuating, and weekly average reports fell below 2,500 in December. Age distribution varies by province: in Kinshasa, people aged over 20 are most affected, while in South Kivu and North Kivu more than 50% of cases are under 10. UNICEF has launched a second round of vaccination in six provinces, including Équateur, North Kivu and South Kivu.

b6JzWySioJuurca8fiI87w.en: Hong Kong reported one new case on 28 January: a 70-year-old man with chronic illness living in Sham Shui Po, who developed difficulty urinating on 21 January, sought medical treatment, and was confirmed by sampling. Authorities are continuing to investigate the source of infection. Since the beginning of this year, cumulative cases total 2; 23 cases were reported in 2024 as a whole.

lAOwYftwHhc4PwpMFMyJDw.zh: 香港報告1例同時感染A型流感及侵襲性肺炎鏈球菌重症病例,為4歲男童,1/5出現發燒、咳嗽及腹痛症狀就醫,1/7再次就醫並住院,經檢驗肺炎鏈球菌陽性,1/8轉院後A型流感(H1)陽性確診,病患出現肺炎症狀,目前病況嚴重,該病患未接種流感疫苗。
lAOwYftwHhc4PwpMFMyJDw.en: Hong Kong reported one severe case of concurrent influenza A and invasive pneumococcal disease: a 4-year-old boy who presented with fever, cough and abdominal pain on 5 January. He sought medical care again and was hospitalised on 7 January, when pneumococcus tested positive. After transfer on 8 January, influenza A (H1) was confirmed. The patient developed pneumonia and is currently in serious condition. The patient had not received influenza vaccination.

jUIyLb1Gi41ZYZSpBrAmZA.zh: 香港於2024年報告135例,較前一年121例增加,當局表示相關案例將進行流行病學調查,以發現可能感染源、高風險因子及群聚個案,呼籲民眾採取預防措施,尤其高風險族群應留意供水設施及水源環境。
jUIyLb1Gi41ZYZSpBrAmZA.en: Hong Kong reported 135 cases in 2024, up from 121 the previous year. Authorities state that the relevant cases will be subject to epidemiological investigation to identify possible sources of infection, high-risk factors and clusters. The public is urged to take preventive measures; high-risk groups in particular should pay attention to water supply facilities and water environments.

wglWVAE3HrdWe1HTRmoVIQ.zh: 韓國疫情上升,去年累計報告6,762例病例,高於前年(2023年)5,926例,去年52週新增291例,病患近6成為0-6歲幼兒;香港疫情上升,去年12/22-28新增報告7例病例,於12/29-2025/1/4則新增19例,多集中於安養機構,當局呼籲加強衛生措施。
wglWVAE3HrdWe1HTRmoVIQ.en: South Korea: Cases are rising. Last year, 6,762 cases were reported cumulatively, higher than the 5,926 cases in the previous year (2023). In week 52 of last year, 291 new cases were reported, and nearly 60% of patients are children aged 0–6. Hong Kong: Cases are rising. From 22 to 28 December last year, 7 new cases were reported, and from 29 December 2024 to 4 January 2025, 19 new cases were reported, mostly concentrated in elderly care facilities. Authorities urge strengthened hygiene measures.

G1sgfVTzvfOWWQhMzwF1vA.zh: 香港12/13新增報告1例病例,為63歲具慢性病史男性,居住於深水埗,11/30發病,12/4死亡,感染源仍在調查中;當地今年累計報告23例病例,較去年17例為高。 美國波多黎各今年7至11月間新增報告6例病例,其中4例死亡,死者均為60歲以上老年族群,當局表示近幾月持續發生大雨及淹水,可能為疫情上升主因。 泰國今年截至12月中旬累計75省報告3,935例病例,其中127例死亡,病患多為男性,年齡層以65歲以上族群最多。
G1sgfVTzvfOWWQhMzwF1vA.en: Hong Kong reported one new case on 13 December: a 63-year-old man with a chronic illness, living in Sham Shui Po, who developed symptoms on 30 November and died on 4 December. The source of infection is still under investigation. Hong Kong has reported 23 cases cumulatively in 2024, higher than the 17 cases in 2023. In the United States, Puerto Rico reported six new cases between July and November 2024, four of which were fatal, all in people over 60; authorities say that heavy rain and flooding over recent months are the main reason for the rise. Thailand reported 3,935 cases cumulatively in 2024 up to mid-December across 75 provinces, with 127 deaths; patients are mostly male, and the largest age group is those aged 65 and over.

fEXHJwo7zo14ZOlA4CaJzA.zh: 香港今年11月新增報告20例病例,其中1例死亡,病患年齡介於42至86歲間,其中17例為男性,18例具慢性病史,7例為自中國移入,其中5例屬同一旅行團(佛山),餘分布於11個社區;香港今年迄今累計報告124例,前2年分別報告80及121例。
fEXHJwo7zo14ZOlA4CaJzA.en: Hong Kong reported 20 new cases in November this year, including 1 death. Patients were aged 42 to 86 years; 17 were male, 18 had chronic conditions, and 7 were imported from mainland China, 5 of whom belonged to the same tour group (Foshan). The remaining cases were distributed across 11 communities. Hong Kong has reported 124 cases so far this year; in the previous two years, 80 and 121 cases were reported respectively.

baWkQiV8lbGYbQrO6u61lA.zh: 香港11/26宣布今年第三季新增85例感染病例及22例愛滋病病例,感染率約0.1%,低於全球平均;感染病例年齡介於18至75歲間,其中72例男性,97%係透過性接觸感染。 ECDC 11/29更新2023年數據,去年歐盟區累計30國報告24,731例感染病例,每10萬人感染率5.3,相較2014年降低16%,傳播方式中,MSM及異性性行為分別佔約3成,經毒品注射感染約4%、經垂直傳染感染約0.9%,餘無相關資訊;另有26國報告2,690例愛滋病例,發病率較10年前降低36%。
baWkQiV8lbGYbQrO6u61lA.en:
On 26 November, Hong Kong announced 85 new infections and 22 new AIDS cases in the third quarter of this year. The infection rate is about 0.1%, lower than the global average. Infected cases were aged 18 to 75 years; 72 were male, and 97% were infected through sexual contact.

On 29 November, ECDC updated its data for 2023. Last year, 30 countries in the EU/EEA reported a cumulative 24,731 infections, a rate of 5.3 per 100,000 population, 16% lower than in 2014. By transmission route, MSM and heterosexual sex each accounted for about 30%, injecting drug use about 4%, and mother-to-child transmission about 0.9%; no relevant information was available for the rest. In addition, 26 countries reported 2,690 AIDS cases, with incidence 36% lower than 10 years earlier.

pmSeIKF1tk41eHU9fSNiXA.zh: 香港11/15新增報告1例病例,為觀塘區80歲具慢性病史男性,10/30發病,感染源調查中;當地今年累計報告22例,較前年全年17例為高。 越南11/20新增報告1例病例,為中北部清化省36歲具慢性病史男性,病情嚴重,病患為挖土機工人,可能係於工作環境感染,當局呼籲有傷口者應避免接觸汙染土壤或水源。
pmSeIKF1tk41eHU9fSNiXA.en:
Hong Kong reported 1 new case on 15 November, a man aged 80 with chronic conditions from Kwun Tong District, with onset on 30 October; the source of infection is under investigation. The city has reported 22 cases so far this year, higher than the full-year total of 17 cases in the year before last.

Viet Nam reported 1 new case on 20 November, a 36-year-old man with chronic conditions from Thanh Hoa Province in north-central Viet Nam. The patient is seriously ill and works as an excavator operator and may have been infected in the work environment. Authorities urge people with wounds to avoid contact with contaminated soil or water.

ZopHfn2io6SW6kLwTY29TQ.zh: 香港11/14新增1例本土病例,為22歲無慢性病史女性,疫苗接種史不明,11/8發病,11/12入院隔離治療,潛伏期多出沒於香港城市大學,當局已進行接觸者追蹤,目前無人發病。 衣索比亞今年截至10月中旬累計報告29,391例病例,其中210例死亡,56%病例為5歲以下兒童,且逾6成未接種疫苗,WHO呼籲加強常規疫苗接種。
ZopHfn2io6SW6kLwTY29TQ.en:
Hong Kong reported 1 new locally acquired case on 14 November, a 22-year-old woman with no chronic conditions, whose vaccination history is unknown, with onset on 8 November. She was admitted to hospital for isolation treatment on 12 November. During the incubation period she frequently visited City University of Hong Kong. Authorities have traced contacts, and no contacts have developed symptoms so far.

Ethiopia has cumulatively reported 29,391 cases this year as of mid-October, including 210 deaths. Children under 5 account for 56% of cases, and more than 60% of cases were unvaccinated. WHO calls for strengthened routine vaccination.

18CufWXrvJAuLPhPI_Q5RA.zh: 香港報告1例腸病毒71型重症病例,為12日齡之新生女嬰,確診腸病毒感染並併發腦膜炎,目前情況穩定。案兄及父親曾出現病徵,現已康復。案兄所在幼教機構曾爆發腸病毒,涉及6名幼童。當局對有病徵幼童進行檢驗,該機構停業並進行消毒。
18CufWXrvJAuLPhPI_Q5RA.en: Hong Kong reported 1 severe enterovirus 71 (EV71) case, a 12-day-old newborn girl. She was confirmed to have an enterovirus infection complicated by meningitis, and her condition is currently stable. The patient's older brother and father had symptoms and have recovered. The early childhood centre attended by the older brother previously had an enterovirus outbreak involving 6 young children. Authorities tested children with symptoms, and the centre was closed for business and disinfected.

6vonci9MxRPuvAiTDBMLlw.zh: 香港今年10月新增報告17例病例,年齡介於55至89歲間,其中10例為男性,1例為自中國移入,餘分布於9個社區,所有病例均具慢性病史;當地今年迄今累計報告104例,前2年分別報告80及121例。
6vonci9MxRPuvAiTDBMLlw.en: Hong Kong reported 17 new cases in October this year, aged 55 to 89 years. Ten were male, 1 was imported from mainland China, and the rest were distributed across 9 communities. All cases had chronic conditions. So far this year, Hong Kong has reported 104 cumulative cases; in the previous two years, 80 and 121 cases were reported, respectively.

Tt7m79IDXK1R-BffSS8X8g.zh: 香港今年10月新增報告6例病例,其中4例來自深水埗,病患年齡介於59至83歲間,多出現發燒、咳嗽、身體腫痛等症狀;當地今年累計報告21例病例,已高於去年全年之17例。
Tt7m79IDXK1R-BffSS8X8g.en: Hong Kong reported 6 new cases in October this year, 4 of them from Sham Shui Po. Patients were aged 59 to 83 years, and most had symptoms such as fever, cough, and body pain and swelling. The city has reported 21 cases so far this year, already exceeding last year's full-year total of 17 cases.

bvQo_IYe24VI3wroidfjDA.zh: 2024年第40週(9/30-10/6)全球陽性率約20.6%,陽性率以歐洲區(22.3%)、美洲區(13.6%)及非洲區(4.9%)為高。 中國更新9月疫情概況,新增159例重症及6例死亡,相較於8月(359例重症/18例死亡)重症數及死亡數皆下降,新冠病毒陽性率自9月初12.8%持續下降至9月底6.1%,發燒門診就診量及類流感就診率呈上下波動,主要流行變異株為JN.1、XDV及其衍生變異株;香港第41週(10/6-10/12)陽性率及定醫就診率呈下降趨勢,JN.1及其衍生變異株爲主要流行變異株,污水監測和人類感染個案中也檢測到 KP.2 和 KP.3。
bvQo_IYe24VI3wroidfjDA.en:
Situation update: In week 40 of 2024 (30 September–6 October), the global positivity rate was about 20.6%, highest in the European Region (22.3%), the Region of the Americas (13.6%) and the African Region (4.9%).

China updated its September situation: 159 new severe cases and 6 deaths were reported, both lower than in August (359 severe cases and 18 deaths). COVID-19 positivity fell from 12.8% in early September to 6.1% at the end of September. Fever clinic visits and influenza-like illness visit rates have fluctuated up and down. The main circulating variants are JN.1, XDV and their derived variants.

Hong Kong's positivity rate and sentinel clinic visit rate in week 41 (6–12 October) declined. JN.1 and its derived variants are the main circulating variants, and KP.2 and KP.3 have also been detected in wastewater surveillance and in human infection cases.

YhiEV-Jq8Ld1Z0QgQ1ETbQ.zh: 2024年第39週(9/23-9/29)全球陽性率約23.7%,陽性率以歐洲區(25.8%)、美洲區(14.2%)及非洲區(5.0%)為高。 香港第40週(9/29-10/5)陽性率持續下降,於污水監測檢出KP.2、KP.3、JN.1、KP.3.1.1、LB.1、JN.1.7及JN.1.18等變異株。 美國近期陽性率、急診就診率及住院率皆呈下降趨勢,主要流行變異株為KP.3.1.1,亦有檢出XEC變異株呈上升趨勢。
YhiEV-Jq8Ld1Z0QgQ1ETbQ.en: Globally, the positivity rate in week 39 of 2024 (23–29 September) was about 23.7%, highest in the European Region (25.8%), the Region of the Americas (14.2%) and the African Region (5.0%). Hong Kong SAR: the positivity rate continued to decline in week 40 (29 September–5 October), and wastewater surveillance detected variants KP.2, KP.3, JN.1, KP.3.1.1, LB.1, JN.1.7 and JN.1.18. United States: recent positivity rate, emergency department visit rate and hospitalization rate have all been declining. The predominant circulating variant is KP.3.1.1, and the XEC variant, which is on an upward trend, has also been detected.
